svg.text: How the Zig experiment compares with Python re
Overall on 3,144 unseen tasks: 0.443× as fast (0.433–0.454× measured range) · 263 clearly faster · 2,644 large slowdowns
Rows show all 76 balanced task families (3,072 tasks); the other 72 varied tasks are retained in the detailed graphs and raw results. Every timed result was checked.
